protocol.description: The legacy interface for input injection: a virtual keyboard does not look like a piece of hardware to the compositor (no backing libinput device), its events go straight to the focused surface. Used by test tooling (this crate) and screen keyboards; ydotool's keyboard half talks the same protocol.

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: An object used to create virtual keyboard objects.

request.name: create_virtual_keyboard
request.description: Creates a new virtual keyboard associated with a seat.

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1
interface.description: The virtual keyboard provides keyboard event injection.

request.name: keymap
request.description: Provide a file descriptor to the compositor which can be memory-mapped to provide a keyboard mapping description in XKB keymap format.
